reportMissingImplementsValue(...) reports invalidImplementsFormat when no story path or req IDs are provided. - reportMissingImplementsReqIds(...) reports invalidImplementsFormat when only a story path is provided. - reportInvalidImplementsStoryPath(...) validates storyPath against options.storyPattern and reports invalidImplementsFormat with detailed message, including the bad path and an example. - reportInvalidImplementsReqId(...) validates each reqId against options.reqPattern and reports invalidReqFormat using buildReqErrorMessage. - validateImplementsAnnotationHelper(...) encapsulates the parsing and validation workflow. - File header JSDoc: - @story docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md - @req REQ-IMPLEMENTS-PARSE, REQ-FORMAT-VALIDATION, REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT. - src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-format-internal.ts - normalizeCommentLine(...) detects @story, @req, and @implements tags, enabling mixed parsing. - Header JSDoc includes @story docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md and @req REQ-IMPLEMENTS-PARSE, REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT, confirming this helper is part of the multi-story support implementation. - src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts - validateImplementsAnnotation(...) constructs deps (including MIN_IMPLEMENTS_TOKENS and the reporter helpers) and delegates to validateImplementsAnnotationHelper(...). - processCommentLine(...) detects @implements with a regex /@implements\b/ and immediately validates it as a single-line annotation, without affecting the existing pending multi-line logic for @story/@req. - processComment(...) iterates all lines and passes them through normalizeCommentLine and processCommentLine, meaning mixed @story/@req/@implements in one block are supported. - meta.messages.invalidImplementsFormat is defined as "Invalid annotation format: {{details}}.", used by @implements error reporters. - Throughout, existing @story/@req validation logic (validateStoryAnnotation, validateReqAnnotation, finalizePendingAnnotation) is preserved, satisfying backward compatibility.
- Deep requirement validation for @implements (REQ-IMPLEMENTS-VALIDATE, REQ-SCOPED-IDS, REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT, REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT): - src/rules/valid-req-reference.ts - IMPLEMENTS_TOKENS constant documents token positions for parsing @implements lines: - STORY_INDEX: 1 - FIRST_REQ_INDEX: 2 - Annotated with @story docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md. - parseImplementsLine(line): - Expects "@implements ...". - Uses IMPLEMENTS_TOKENS to read storyPath and reqIds. - Returns null if storyPath is missing or no reqIds are present (invalid formats ignored by deep rule, as the story notes are acceptable for deep validation). - JSDoc: - @story docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md - @req REQ-IMPLEMENTS-VALIDATE, REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT, REQ-SCOPED-IDS. - validateImplementsLine({ comment, context, line, cwd, reqCache }): - Parses the line via parseImplementsLine; returns early if invalid. - Calls resolveStoryAndRequirements(...) with the storyPath from the @implements line. - resolveStoryAndRequirements uses validateAndResolveStoryPath (path traversal and absolute-path checks) and loadAndCacheRequirements (per-file requirement ID cache) to obtain reqSet for the specific story file. - For each reqId, calls checkRequirementExists({ reqId, storyPath, reqSet }). - checkRequirementExists reports: - messageId: 'reqMissing' - data: { reqId, storyPath } - This satisfies REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT and the acceptance criterion that error messages clearly indicate which story was checked. - handleAnnotationLine(...) extended to: - On line.startsWith("@implements"), call validateImplementsLine while leaving @story/@req behavior unmodified. - Returns the existing storyPath, so @implements can coexist with and not disturb @story/@req handling in the same comment (REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT). - loadAndCacheRequirements(...) caches requirements per resolvedStoryPath, enabling the same requirement ID (e.g. REQ-SHARED-ID) to be reused across multiple files without conflict (REQ-SCOPED-IDS). - meta.messages: - reqMissing: "Requirement '{{reqId}}' not found in '{{storyPath}}'" (includes storyPath in the message). - invalidPath: "Invalid story path '{{storyPath}}'".

traceability.notes: All functional and technical requirements for story docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md are implemented and thoroughly tested. The codebase supports the @implements annotation format, validates its story path and requirement IDs, integrates it into both format-level and deep requirement validation rules, preserves backward compatibility with existing @story/@req annotations, and correctly handles mixed usage and per-story requirement ID scoping. Error messages include the relevant story path, and there are dedicated tests that reference this story explicitly. Jest tests run successfully via `npm test -- --runInBand --verbose`, confirming the implementation is complete and stable.
